09.03.05.13 A presentation of information is not an invention. 
Any manner, me ans or method of expressing information whether 
visual, audible or tangible by words, codes, signals, symbols, diagrams 
or any other mode of representation is not patentable. For example, a 
speech instruction means in the form of printed text where horizon tal 
underlining indicated stress and vertical separating lines divided the 
works into rhythmic groups is not patentable. For instance, railway 
time table, 100 years calendar etc.
